items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 12:1
items.html: It is known that the Malchut that served in the Partzufim of AK — namely, the Malchut of the first restriction — was concealed in the mouth of RADLA, and there is no longer any coupling upon it in all the Partzufim of Atzilut. Nevertheless, the illumination of this Malchut is necessarily present in Atzilut as well; otherwise there would be no existence for raising female waters sufficient to return the AHAP to their levels. For in the screen of the Malchut of the second restriction, which was born from its very beginning with the deficiency of these AHAP, there would be found no aspect of female waters — that is, an arousal — with which to draw again the AHAP that operated in the first restriction, and it would remain deficient of AHAP from the very beginning of its Atzilut. And this is the secret of the necessity that in every coupling there are two drops, in the secret of 'two drops rising from below' — namely, that two aspects of Malchut must be included in them: the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction causes the heating and the arousal to draw the AHAP missing to the level; and the aspect of the Malchut of the second restriction receives the coupling and the descent of the male waters, for there is no aspect of coupling upon the Malchut of the first restriction in Atzilut, after it was concealed in RADLA, as above. And this is the secret of 'one drop descending from above,' namely the drop of male waters received by the Malchut of the second restriction alone.
